messages:
alex: FYI main is red after merge 4521 — integration-stage is timing out on the e2e-run step, hitting 15m and then the job aborts. I tried one rerun but it failed same way. https://ci.redwood.com/builds/98432 :eyes:
maria: ack — any failing test names or just a timeout? do we have a recent dep bump in that PR?
sam: looks like the PR only touched docs + a small deps update to proto-gen. unclear why integration would time out. can someone paste the failing step logs?
alex: logs: ```[2024-03-05T14:12:21Z] starting e2e-run
[2024-03-05T14:27:21Z] step exceeded 900s, aborting
No obvious stacktrace, just stall while sending requests to local test harness.```
ci-bot: RERUN queued by @alex — build 98433 started (retry 1). Job: integration-stage/e2e-run
ryan-oncall: i'll grab this. ping me if you see flaky network in infra metrics — i'll check infra/az routing.
alex: thanks! one thing: the harness container logs show repeated `ConnectionResetError` when talking to redis-mock. low-level network drops maybe.
maria: did the PR change any env var or ingress rules?
sam: no env changes. proto-gen bump only. i can try a bisect on master -> revert the proto-gen commit locally and run the e2e subset. quick test: `git checkout HEAD~1 && ./scripts/run-e2e.sh --filter=integration`
ryan-oncall: looking at host metrics now — no cluster-wide CPU or network spikes. i'll tail the redis-mock pod logs and kube events for the last 30m.
deploy-bot: Notifying owners for integration-stage. Escalation: if rerun fails twice, consider pinning to previous proto-gen for a hotfix commit.
ci-bot: RERUN completed — build 98433 FAILED (same timeout).
alex: ok rerun failed. sam — can you run the local bisect? if it repros locally we can fast revert.
sam: starting local bisect now. if it fails locally i'll open a revert PR and request hotfix. ETA ~20m.
ryan-oncall: i see intermittent 502s from redis-mock around the same timeframe; investigating whether the mock has a new image rotation. tagging infra: @maria @sam
maria: thanks ryan. if infra confirms rotation, we can coordinate rollback or patch the mock to be more resilient.
sam: local bisect shows the proto-gen commit DOESN'T repro the timeout locally — tests pass. looks like infra-only.
alex: great signal. ryan any luck with pod restarts/image changes?
ryan-oncall: found a cron job that pulled a new redis-mock image 14:10 UTC (exactly when the pipeline started). image had a new default conn-setting that closed idle sockets sooner. i've rolled back the image to previous tag; triggering a new rerun now.
ci-bot: RERUN queued by @ryan-oncall — build 98434 started (retry 2).
deploy-bot: Reminder: update the infra change log and add a note about redis-mock conn settings.
ci-bot: RERUN completed — build 98434 PASSED. :tada:
alex: awesome — thanks everyone for the quick turnaround. i'll close the thread and add a blurb to the postmortem about infra image rotations and our pipeline hardening (increase e2e timeouts + retry harness).
maria: +1. can we add an alert for image-pulls during runs? that would've flagged earlier.
ryan-oncall: noted. i'll open an infra ticket to gate image updates during CI windows.
sam: i'll draft the revert/hotfix checklist in case this reappears.
